name: Bxn Holding Co., Ltd.
summary: Bxn Holding Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of branded men and women clothing products in China. Its products include suits, trousers, shirts, jackets, sheep sweaters, POLO shirts, down jackets, quick-drying clothes, casual pants, leather shoes, and leather goods. The company sells its products through retail market, e-commerce, live broadcasting, online and offline channels.
